output_text: I can confirm that Helix Bank currently does not charge fees for domestic wire transfers. However, for international wire transfers, there may be fees charged by the recipient's bank or the foreign financial institution. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, I recommend checking the Helix Bank website or contacting us through the mobile app or our secure phone line at 1-800-HELIX-CS.<|im_end|>
